messages:
opsbot: [P1] ALERT — Streaming tail latency breach detected for model gpt-open-xx in eu-west-1. p99 = 4.8s (SLO 3s), p95 = 1.2s. Spike started ~03:14 UTC. Auto-snapshot: quant-calib job reported high variance during rollout. :rotating_light:

opsbot: Affected routes: /v1/stream, /v1/chat/stream. Error pattern: repeated stalls during chunk flush, clients reporting stalls and dropped frames. Auto-fallback triggered for 12% of traffic.

sophie (oncall): taking this. paging ben and marco, will run initial triage. any immediate customer escalations? :phone:

elaine (support): Support inbound: two enterprise customers opened tickets (INC-3421, INC-3422) reporting multi-second pauses during streaming replies. They see p99 > 5s on their dashboards. Customer-facing note drafted, holding until we know root cause.

marco (eng-runtime): quick summary from runtime metrics: we rolled a new quantization profile (int8-autocalib v3) at 03:12 UTC on the gpt-open-xx fleet. KV-cache hit-rate unchanged, but token emission stalls line up with calibration checkpoint writes. CPU stalls on workers doing dequant step look correlated.

marco (eng-runtime): hypothesis: calibration code path introduced extra mutexing when precision fallback occurs, causing serialization on streaming hotshards. Repro on staging with similar profile replicates stalls.

ben (eng-sre): oncall checklist: 1) isolate by routing to fp16-compatible variant for streaming 2) pause/resume autocalib rollout 3) scale up dedicated workers for streaming routes. I'll start routing change now.

ben (eng-sre): routing change command (running):
```bash
redwood routing apply --policy prefer:fp16-compat --route /v1/stream --region eu-west-1 --reason "mitigate int8 calibration stalls"
```

sophie (oncall): ben, confirm when route switch is live. marco, can we prepare a rollback for the int8 profile? need minimal blast radius.

marco (eng-runtime): rollback ready. command to revert profile on fleet:
```bash
redwood model-profile rollback --model gpt-open-xx --profile-id int8-autocalib-v2 --target all --dry-run false
```
I'll hold until ben confirms routing so we don't create flapping.

ben (eng-sre): routing switch completed at 03:28 UTC. traffic to /v1/stream in eu-west-1 now preferring fp16-compat variants. p99 dropped to 2.1s within two minutes. :thumbsup:

elaine (support): customer INC-3421 updated: they report latency improving but still see intermittent 800ms pauses. telling them we are rolling rollback for calibration profile; will update once done.

marco (eng-runtime): starting rollback of int8-autocalib v3 to v2 at 03:33 UTC. doing canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated checks (p95/p99, stall-rate). watch metrics: streaming stall count, dequant mutex wait time.

opsbot: AUTOCALIB: rollback job started (job id: acb-98721). Canary 5% -> passed checks at 03:37. 25% staging running.

sophie (oncall): handoff: I'll stay through the rollback and then hand to ben for post-mortem and long-term mitigations. ben you're primary for postmortem. carlos, can you draft a short status page update for customers?

carlos (product): drafting status page and customer note now. will include timeline, mitigation steps, and next steps (root cause analysis and ETA for stable autocalib).

ben (eng-sre): rollback to v2 completed at 03:46 UTC. p99 steady at 1.9s, p95 0.9s. stall-rate ~90% lower than peak. marking incident as mitigated for live traffic.

marco (eng-runtime): logged instrumentation: added additional KV-cache and dequant mutex telemetry to help root-cause RCA. preliminary root cause: int8-autocalib v3 introduced an eager write path that touched a global lock when fallback paths triggered under streaming interleaving — rare under typical load but surfaced during higher concurrency.

elaine (support): updated INC-3421/3422 with mitigation and apology. offering proactive monitoring for impacted customers for 24h.

carlos (product): status page posted. customers notified. tracking for an RCA doc and release block on autocalib v3 until fix and e2e tests added.

ben (eng-sre): next actions (assigned):
- marco: root cause PR + unit/regression tests for mutex-free fallback (ETA 48h)
- eng-runtime: add canary gating by stall-rate for future autocalib rollouts (ETA 72h)
- oncall: monitor eu-west-1 streaming over next 24h, escalations to be paged to ben directly
- support/product: customer follow-ups and SLA credit assessment if needed

sophie (oncall): marking this thread as active-ongoing until RCA merged. I'm leaving the live handoff to ben at 04:05 UTC. thanks all — great coordination. :pray:

opsbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitored. postmortem requested. incident severity remains P1 until RCA complete.

ben (eng-sre): taking over as incident owner for postmortem. will open a dedicated RCA doc and invite runtime + ml infra.

marco (eng-runtime): quick note: saved trace snapshot to s3://redwood-incidents/6755554321/trace-03-14.tar.gz for troubleshooting.

sophie (oncall): handing off now. ben, you're oncall owner. I'll still be reachable if needed.

ben (eng-sre): ack. closing live paging. continuing with RCA follow-ups.

opsbot: End of thread log.
